container.$description: Max-width of a container or content column (use as max-width; the content stays fluid below it). Same on every platform. For page structure use the grid; for spacing use spacing tokens.

xs.$description: Max-width 384. Small dialogs (confirm, single question), toasts.

sm.$description: Max-width 480. Default dialog, simple forms in a dialog.

md.$description: Max-width 560. Large dialog, side sheet, multi-field forms in a dialog.

lg.$description: Max-width 640. Single-column page forms, settings panels.

xl.$description: Max-width 768. Reading column for long text (about 70 characters per line), detail pages.

2xl.$description: Max-width 1024. Medium content area — wizards, detail pages with a side column.

3xl.$description: Max-width 1280. Default maximum width of main page content on wide screens.

4xl.$description: Max-width 1440. Wide data screens — dashboards, large tables. Never wider.

icon.$description: Icon box sizes. Material Symbols optical sizes are 20, 24, 40 and 48 (md, lg, 2xl, 3xl); other sizes scale the nearest one. On touch, a tappable icon keeps a target-min hit area.

xs.$description: Icon 12. Indicators and decoration only (status glyph inside a badge or chip). Never the only carrier of meaning.

sm.$description: Icon 16. Dense web: inside sm controls, table cells, inline with caption or small text.

md.$description: Icon 20 (optical size). Default on web: inside md controls, menus, list rows, inline with body text.

lg.$description: Icon 24 (optical size). Default on tablet and mobile: inside lg and xl controls, app bars, navigation.

xl.$description: Icon 32. Emphasis: leading icon of a banner, avatar fallback at xl.

2xl.$description: Icon 40 (optical size). Feature or section icons, small empty states.

3xl.$description: Icon 48 (optical size). Empty states, onboarding, large illustrative icons.

control.$description: Height of controls with a fixed height (Button, Icon button, Split button, Text field, Select, Segmented button). One size per row: controls side by side share a size. Components that sit in the same row as controls (Avatar) may use these heights through their component tokens so they line up. Touch platforms default to lg; xl is tablet/mobile primary actions only.

sm.$description: Control height 32. Dense web only: tables, toolbars, filters. On touch never without a target-min hit area.

lg.$description: Control height 48. Default on tablet and mobile (= touch target).

xl.$description: Control height 56. Prominent tablet/mobile primary action (full-width buttons). Not on web.

height.$description: Control height by size. Pair with spacing.control.*.{same size}.
